answer: Embed every answer as a semantic vector on-ledger and collapse tight near-duplicate clusters into a single identity, orthogonal to funding and IP graphs. Honest agents reason along paths that genuinely wander across distinct arguments; a clone farm fanning one template over 1000 fresh keys leaves each submission tinted the same jade, so every near-duplicate ripples straight back into one cluster and earns one vote, never 1000. The attacker's real cost is producing 1000 independently original analyses, not spinning cheap wallets behind a recycled script.
